title: Add Python test suite
prompt: `src/geometry.py` exports `area` and `perimeter` for rectangles but has no tests. Create `test/test_geometry.py` using `unittest` that asserts the real behaviour of both, including the degenerate zero-size case, and exits non-zero on failure when run with `py -3 test/test_geometry.py`. Do not modify `src/geometry.py`.
